title: Adjectives agree with nouns
summary: Adjectives follow the noun’s gender, number and case. Here “degree 3” means the superlative.

fem.note: Adjective in the nominative, feminine singular.

neuter.note: Adjective in the nominative, neuter singular.

instrumental.note: Adjective in the instrumental, feminine singular.

genitive.sentenceGloss: This is advice from a decisive friend.
genitive.note: Adjective in the genitive, masculine singular.

accusative.note: Adjective in the accusative, feminine singular.

superf.sentenceGloss: She is the best female friend.
superf.note: Superlative with най-; the adjective still agrees with the noun.

superm.sentenceGloss: This is the tallest building in the street.
superm.note: Superlative with най-; the adjective still agrees with the noun.
